    For a first visit Little London & Woodhouse
    Higher caution advisedday Higher caution advisednight
    6 of the city's main sights are close enough to walk between. Still a practical base for a first visit: the rating is driven by shoplifting during the day and violence after dark, counted as a rate against the 31,076 people registered as living here rather than the far larger number who pass through. Take extra care, particularly after dark — that is what the rating is for, not a reason to stay out of the area. Find a place in Little London & Woodhouse →
